mech_note: Forbidden Rite: chaos spell that costs life to cast (in addition to mana), dealing chaos damage plus launching seeking chaos projectiles that home on enemies. The self-damage cost makes the player pay HP per cast, creating a life-floor pressure. Totem delivery (Spellslinger or FR Totem) makes the TOTEM pay the blood price instead — totems have no life penalty feedback to the player. CI (Chaos Inoculation) makes chaos damage bypass ES irrelevant (CI sets life to 1 but ES absorbs all chaos from other sources). Blood Magic keystone enables life-paying builds that remove mana as a constraint. Emerged as a legitimate league-start skill in 3.15-3.17 for Solo Self-Found (SSF) due to requiring zero specific unique items. Strong chaos-damage ceiling; the self-damage cost is the tuning knob, not an intrinsic flaw.
